title: Total weight of restriction assignments
statement: For any nonnegative integer $n$, assign independently to each of the $n$ coordinates one of three restrictions: leave it free, fix it to $1$, or fix it to $-1$. Give these choices respective weights $1/2$, $1/4$, and $1/4$, and give an assignment the product of its coordinate weights. The sum of the weights of all restriction assignments is $1$.
